heard: Reviewers called this groundbreaking space discovery utter nonsense. In 1958, astrophysicist Eugene Parker used just four lines of algebra to prove the million-degree solar corona must rapidly expand outward into the solar system. When Parker submitted his bold paper to the Astrophysical Journal, two expert reviewers firmly recommended rejection. However, fearless journal editor Subramanyan Chandrasekar bravely overruled them and published the historic manuscript anyway. Just months later, Soviet spacecraft Luna 1 directly detected this invisible stream tearing through the void. Today, we know this supersonic plasma torrent races across the solar system at a million miles per hour. Reviewers call this groundbreaking space Discovery Utter Nonsense.
differences: 'subrahmanyan chandrasekhar' heard as 'subramanyan chandrasekar' after 'fearless journal editor'
